description: This file defines functions and types for generating, processing, and matching ARIA (Accessible Rich Internet Applications) node trees, including serialization to YAML format, matching against templates, and handling ARIA roles and properties within a web accessibility context.

classes.name: AriaNode
classes.description: Represents an ARIA node with role, name, properties, and children, used for accessibility tree generation.

classes.name: AriaSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of the ARIA tree, including root node, element map, and reference map.

methods.name: toInternalOptions
methods.description: Converts user-specified options into internal configuration for ARIA tree generation.

methods.name: generateAriaTree
methods.description: Generates an ARIA node tree snapshot from a root DOM element based on specified options.

methods.name: computeAriaRef
methods.description: Computes and assigns a reference ID for an ARIA node based on visibility and interaction settings.

methods.name: toAriaNode
methods.description: Creates an ARIA node representation from a DOM element, extracting role, name, and properties.

methods.name: normalizeGenericRoles
methods.description: Removes redundant 'generic' roles from ARIA nodes when appropriate.

methods.name: normalizeStringChildren
methods.description: Normalizes text children within ARIA nodes, consolidating strings and removing unnecessary nodes.

methods.name: matchesText
methods.description: Checks if a text matches a string or regex pattern.

methods.name: matchesTextNode
methods.description: Checks if a text node matches a template.

methods.name: matchesName
methods.description: Checks if a node's accessible name matches a template.

methods.name: matchesExpectAriaTemplate
methods.description: Matches DOM elements against an ARIA template, returning matching nodes and serialized output.

methods.name: getAllElementsMatchingExpectAriaTemplate
methods.description: Returns all DOM elements matching an ARIA template.

methods.name: matchesNode
methods.description: Checks if an ARIA node matches a given ARIA template.

methods.name: listEqual
methods.description: Checks if two lists of ARIA nodes or strings are equal.

methods.name: containsList
methods.description: Checks if a list of ARIA nodes contains a sublist matching a template.

methods.name: matchesNodeDeep
methods.description: Recursively searches for nodes matching a template within an ARIA node tree.

methods.name: renderAriaTree
methods.description: Serializes an ARIA snapshot into a YAML-like string format for visualization or testing.

methods.name: convertToBestGuessRegex
methods.description: Converts a string into a regex pattern with heuristics for dynamic content.

methods.name: textContributesInfo
methods.description: Determines if a text string adds meaningful information compared to a node's name.

methods.name: hasPointerCursor
methods.description: Checks if an ARIA node has a pointer cursor style.
